column1: # FROST / Ed25519 threshold signature golden vectors for SAS (#534).
# These vectors pin the cryptographic contract behind schemas that declare
# `FrostGroup` in `SchemaRegistry::set_schema_frost_group`: a FROST aggregate
# is an ordinary RFC 8032 Ed25519 signature under the group public key, so
# SAS verifies it with one `ed25519_verify` call, exactly like a single-signer
# delegated attestation.
# Columns are tab-separated:
#   1. expected result: `ok` or `insufficient-threshold`
#   2. threshold t
#   3. max_signers n
#   4. group seed (32-byte hex). TEST-ONLY key material: the deterministic
#      dealer derives the t polynomial coefficients from this seed, then the
#      Shamir shares at x = 1..n, so the vectors are fully reproducible.
#   5. group public key A (32-byte compressed Ed25519 point, hex)
#   6. signing set (1-based share indices, comma separated)
#   7. public share A_i for each signing index, in the same order (hex)
#   8. message (32-byte hex; stands in for the SAS delegated payload digest)
#   9. aggregate signature R || s (64-byte hex)
# For `ok` rows, the signing set size is >= t, the signature verifies under A
# with a standard Ed25519 verifier, and A equals the Lagrange-weighted sum of
# the listed public shares. For `insufficient-threshold` rows, fewer than t
# shares contributed and the aggregate does NOT verify under A.
# DO NOT reuse any of this key material for a production group.
ok
ok
insufficient-threshold
